tasks.short: Observe work or witness tests and collect the data.

steps.what: Prepare the sheet for observation of work activities.
Observe work activities or witness the tests.
Test lead conducts the witnessed tests.
Record the observation data while it is still fresh.

tasks.design: An observation sheet can be prepared in {DOCS} from the task list. The engineer still watches the work or the test. The record is filed only after the engineer checks that it says what was seen, and it does not score a named person's performance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sheets were blank, so the write-up happened later from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheet can be ready before the visit. Seeing the work cannot move.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing a workaround the sheet did not ask about.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer was there and will not file a behaviour that was not seen.
tasks.altitude: Observation stays most of this time. The engineer can refuse a record that a sheet suggested but the visit did not show.

reach.task: Time a task cycle on the same work
reach.learn: Which cycles are normal and which were performed for the observer

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a task list to a filed observation. Changing the workplace is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} checklist before custom code.
Structured fields are task, time, event and note. The engineer produces the note. Fallback: a blank row stays blank.
If the record would check behaviour or performance, works-council consent comes first. No scoring of a named worker.
unknowns: Whether observation is agreed with the people watched.
Whether a test lead is present.
research_questions: Which observations are allowed to name a person?

already_counted.description: Checking the record against what was seen

incremental.description: Keep observation fields from turning into a performance score

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated task with a stable sheet saves only preparation. Watching the work and writing what was seen stay. The low case is a first visit with no agreed sheet.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview users about needs, fatigue, ergonomics and interfaces.

steps.what: Draft the interviews guide for fatigue and ergonomics.

loop.input: Study question and known interface issues
loop.output: Guide with questions on fatigue, needs and the interface
loop.check: Engineer removes a question the study did not ask
loop.stop: One draft; a question with no study purpose is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: Each study's questions differ, so a fixed script is not enough

steps.what: Hold the interviews with users on requirements.
Customer describes needs during the interviews.
Group the interviews notes by fatigue and needs.

loop.output: Theme list: fatigue, need or interface, with the note reference
loop.check: Engineer checks each theme against the note
loop.stop: One pass; a theme with no note is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: Notes are prose, not ticks on one form

steps.what: Check that the themes match what users said.

tasks.design: A guide can be drafted in {DOCS} from the study question. The interviews stay a conversation. Themes are proposed from the notes and kept only if the engineer can point at what the user said.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guides were rewritten for every study, and themes were sorted by hand at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: The guide and a first grouping can be prepared. The interview itself stays.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing a need the guide did not name, and not forcing it into a theme.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer heard the person and will not file a theme the words do not support.
tasks.altitude: Interviews stay the bulk of the week. The engineer can drop a theme that has no note behind it.

reach.task: Describe the task the interview is about
reach.learn: Which task steps users are likely to skip when they talk

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.
Grouping notes is not a substitute for the interview.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a study question to checked themes. Designing the interface is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} guide template before custom code.
Structured fields are question, theme and note reference. The user produces the account. Fallback: the engineer types a theme the grouping missed.
Interviews are not recorded for performance scoring. Consent is asked first.
unknowns: Whether users can be named in the theme file.
How many interviews the study requires.
research_questions: Which themes need a second interview before they are treated as a requirement?

already_counted.description: Fixing a guide question the draft got wrong

incremental.description: Keep theme names stable across studies without hiding a new need

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated question set saves guide drafting and some grouping. The interviews and the check stay. The low case is a first study with no prior notes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advocate for users with engineers, designers and managers.

steps.what: Assemble the users' evidence for the collaboration.

loop.input: User evidence and the design proposal
loop.output: Pack: user point, source and the design item it touches
loop.check: Engineer checks each point against the source
loop.stop: One pass; a point with no source is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: Evidence is notes and clips, not a fixed brief

steps.what: Advocate for users with designers and managers.
Designer responds to the users' point.
Record what was agreed for the users.

loop.input: Meeting outcome and the design response
loop.output: Record of the agreement, the dissent and the evidence used
loop.check: Engineer deletes an agreement that was not reached
loop.stop: One draft; a point nobody accepted is marked open
loop.why_not_simpler: The record must follow the meeting, not the pack alone

tasks.design: User evidence is packed in {DOCS} with a source for each point. The engineer still advocates in the meeting with designers and managers. The decision record is filed only after it matches what was actually agreed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence was reassembled before every meeting, and the agreement lived in someone's notes.
tasks.enabler_now: The pack can be ready before the meeting. The advocacy stays a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which user point to press when the room pushes back.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer represents the user and will not record a concession that was not made.

ambition.what: Bring the same evidence pack to each design review, instead of arguing from memory.

tasks.altitude: Advocacy meetings stay. The engineer can refuse to file an agreement the meeting did not reach.

reach.task: Explain a hardware limit that blocks a user request
reach.learn: Which user points the hardware cannot meet, so the argument stays honest

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A meeting that defends users is not a document the pack can hold.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from user evidence to a filed decision. Detailed hardware design is out of scope.
Structured fields are user point, source, design item and agreed or open. Studies produce the evidence. Fallback: the engineer types a point raised only in the room.
unknowns: Who in the room can change the design.
Whether dissent must be visible to the user.
research_questions: Which agreements need the user's confirmation before they are treated as accepted?

already_counted.description: Checking the record against the meeting
Dropping pack points the source does not support

incremental.description: Keep evidence sources findable for the next review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A study that already has sourced points saves pack preparation. The meeting and the wording of the agreement stay. The low case is a review with new evidence.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect work sites and identify physical hazards.

steps.what: Read prior incidents before inspecting work sites.

loop.input: Incident summaries and the floor plan
loop.output: Plan: location, prior incident type and what to look at
loop.check: Engineer checks each location against the plan
loop.stop: One pass; a location with no access note stays listed
loop.why_not_simpler: Incident files are not a floor walk

steps.what: Inspect work sites and mark physical hazards.
Identify which hazards need a change now.
File the hazards found on the work sites.

loop.output: Hazard list with location, hazard and whether it is urgent
loop.check: Engineer removes a hazard that was not marked on site
loop.stop: One draft; an urgent flag the judgement did not set is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The list must match the inspection, not the old incidents alone

tasks.design: Prior incidents can point at locations in {DOCS}. The engineer still inspects the work sites and decides which physical hazards need a change now. The list is filed only for hazards that were marked on site.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each inspection started from memory of the last incident file.
tasks.enabler_now: A location list can be ready before the walk. Finding and judging hazards stays on site.
tasks.still_hard: A hazard the plan did not mention and the floor shows clearly.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not file a hazard that was not seen, or ignore one the plan skipped.

ambition.what: Re-inspect a site after a change, not only after an incident.

tasks.altitude: Site inspections stay. The engineer can refuse a list item that was not marked on the walk.

reach.task: Trace the task that happens at the hazardous location
reach.learn: Which hazards are part of the task and which are the workplace

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A prior incident list does not inspect a floor.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from prior incidents to a filed hazard list. Remedial construction is out of scope.
Test {DOCS} and {HELPDESK} fields before custom code.
Structured fields are location, hazard, urgent or not, and source (plan or site). The engineer produces site marks. Fallback: a hazard found on site is typed and marked as seen.
unknowns: Who must act on an urgent hazard the same day.
research_questions: Which hazards need a specialist beyond this inspection?

incremental.description: Keep location names aligned with the floor plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A known floor with prior incidents saves the plan. The walk and the urgency judgement stay. The low case is a site with no plan and no history.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Observation, interviews, user advocacy and site inspections stay on the week. Lists and guides take less rewriting.
reach: Industrial engineers timing the same task
Mechanical engineers explaining a hardware limit
skills_to_grow: Filing only what was seen or said
Keeping observation from becoming a performance score
Re-inspecting after a change, not only after an incident
role.ambitious_version: The engineer still stands on the floor and in the interview, and will not file a hazard, a theme or an agreement the evidence does not hold.
